about.title: Local care, done right
body: S.M Clinic sits right on Kundrathur Main Road in Jayalakshmi Nagar, Madhanandapuram — close enough that most patients walk in rather than drive. That was the point: healthcare shouldn't mean fighting traffic to Porur or Poonamallee for a fever or a routine checkup.

We've built the clinic around straightforward, unhurried consultations. You see the doctor, get examined properly, get your questions answered in plain Tamil or English, and walk out with a clear plan — not a stack of referral slips.
highlights: Steps from Jayalakshmi Nagar and Madhanandapuram households
Morning and evening hours around the workday
On-site basic diagnostics for common tests
Doctors who explain things in Tamil or English, whichever is easier

blogPosts.title: Why a Quick Appointment Shouldn't Mean a Rushed One
blogPosts.excerpt: A fast appointment and a thorough one aren't opposites. Here's how a neighbourhood clinic visit can respect your time without cutting corners on care.
blogPosts.author: Dr. Senthil Murugan
content: Most people assume a quick doctor's visit means a rushed one — five minutes, a hurried prescription, and out the door with more questions than you walked in with. It doesn't have to be that way.

The real time sink in most clinic visits isn't the consultation itself, it's everything around it: long waits, confusing paperwork, being sent across town for basic tests. Cut that out, and the actual conversation with your doctor can stay unhurried while your total time at the clinic still drops sharply.

That's the model we've built at S.M Clinic — streamlined check-in, on-site basic diagnostics, and evening hours so you're not choosing between work and a checkup. But the consultation itself is never rushed; the doctor takes the time needed to actually explain what's going on.

If your last doctor's visit felt like you were rushed out before your questions were answered, that's not something you have to accept as normal. Being close to home in Madhanandapuram and being thorough can go together — that's exactly the gap we set out to close.
